The server component has been created at `/vercel/sandbox/app/page.tsx` that displays the current server timestamp on each request. The timestamp will be different on every page load as it uses `new Date().toISOString()` which generates the current timestamp dynamically on each request.

The component uses Next.js's recommended approach for dynamic data by simply generating the timestamp on each render without needing to opt out of static prerendering explicitly, as server components are dynamic by default when they contain dynamic data.
